description: P&L summaries per period: metrics (EBIT, EBITDA, margins, depreciation, financial, tax) and category_totals, as result effect (revenue +, expense −). Each summary's metrics.category_totals_sort_order gives the GuV-Explorer display order per category (lower sorts first). granularity quarter, year or total sums the months in the tool and re-derives the metrics. Per-account balances are omitted by default; include_account_totals=true adds `totals` per summary. include_previous compares each summary with its CALENDAR predecessor (loaded automatically; granularity total has none): previous_period, previous_comparison (per headline figure: current, previous, delta_absolute, delta_percentage) and delta_category_totals (same keys as category_totals, with label_ids, current, previous and the deltas). A category without bookings in a period that has computed metrics counts as 0, not null; delta_percentage is null when the previous value is 0. All deltas are null (not 0) when a side has no computed metrics. For quarter/year, if the bucket or its predecessor covers fewer months than the bucket length (3/12; see months_covered and previous_months_covered), all deltas are null and a warning names the period. Every response carries available_range ({from, to}, YYYY-MM); requested months without a ledger row are listed in missing_periods and named in a warning. An invalid period such as 2026-13 is rejected.

date_from.description: Start of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM), additive to `periods`. Independent of date_to — given alone, the range runs through the tenant's last available period. Omit both for all data.

date_to.description: End of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM), additive to `periods`. Independent of date_from — given alone, the range starts at the tenant's first available period. Omit both for all data.

granularity.description: Time bucket of the returned figures: 'month' (default), 'quarter', 'year' or 'total'. The tool rolls the months up itself.

include_account_totals.description: Attach `totals` (one row per account/sub-account with period_balance and account_ref) to every summary (default false: omitted, answer stays small).

include_previous.description: Attach previous_period/previous_comparison/delta_category_totals to each summary, comparing it against the calendar predecessor (default false).

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

name: get_periodic_summaries
